confirmed_decisions.timestamp: unsigned64 1MHz; STOP/clear fault/DMA reset preserve; PL reconfiguration new epoch
confirmed_decisions.stop: finish current pulse timing, cancel session
confirmed_decisions.position: invalid on power-up; HOME or explicit maintenance REBASE; no automatic EN recovery
confirmed_decisions.dma_first: Anlogic AXI DMA HP0 64-bit stream simple mode; one record per packet; Linux DMAengine validation
confirmed_decisions.step_dir: STEP rising edge counted, idle low; DIR=1 positive; EN polarity explicit parameter
confirmed_decisions.safety_edge_priority: STOP/underflow/fault inhibit new same-cycle edge; retain already emitted count
confirmed_decisions.maintenance_rebase: EN disabled, idle, no session or pending command; load signed64 and set valid; HOME uses same commit; DISABLE invalidates
confirmed_decisions.single_axis_stop_enable: finish high/low and DIR hold; cancel session; retain EN for STOP/underflow/ordinary fault; DISABLE releases after safe stop and explicit delay
confirmed_decisions.single_axis_reset_clear: reset immediately idles STEP/disables EN/invalidates position and may truncate pulse; clear fault never restores session or EN; explicit new session required
confirmed_decisions.four_axis_scheduler: common Nmax=max(abs(delta_i)) slots; integer remainder emits exactly Ni; all nonzero axes emit in first slot
confirmed_decisions.four_axis_correspondence: actual rising edges in the same slot are corresponding; same-clock PL logical outputs in this phase; driver inputs require later measurement
confirmed_decisions.four_axis_feasibility: checked duration_tick*100; common conservative DIR/EN/low guard; whole group validated before output; final high/low/hold within duration; any infeasible axis rejects and cancels whole session
confirmed_decisions.four_axis_phase_scope: atomic single point with exact duration and common stop; normal point completion retains session; explicit upstream underflow; continuous FIFO/normal END/pause deferred
confirmed_decisions.continuous_end: END final point completes full duration/pulse safety; close session, retain EN/actual position; no underflow; reject further same-session points after END accepted
confirmed_decisions.continuous_pause: PAUSE at current point boundary including same-cycle request; retain FIFO/prefetch/session/EN; explicit RESUME from next relative interval; exclude paused wall time; STOP/fault > END completion > PAUSE
confirmed_decisions.continuous_sequence: logical u32 from 0 strictly contiguous without wrap; duplicate/gap/order/post-END cancels current session; old session handshake discarded with stale, isolated from current session; OPEN idle/flushed with new nonzero globally unique upstream ID
confirmed_decisions.continuous_start: first point prechecked plus explicit START_MIN_POINTS and config/position/EN safety; complete cached END allows short trajectory below threshold
confirmed_decisions.continuous_underflow: boundary without prechecked next point cancels and flushes FIFO/all prefetch/prediction; same-cycle late point cannot rescue; STOP/fault/reset likewise flush; retain emitted count except reset zero/invalid; never restore old session
confirmed_decisions.continuous_scope: additive logical record interface; wire layout/CRC/product capacity/driver timing remain draft or explicit parameters; no AXI/DMA/BSP/hardware integration
